object.name: evi.ramp0~
object.digest: Ramp generator, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause
object.description: A bit like MSP <o>ramp~</o>, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause.
object.discussion: I made this for my friend Rodrigo Constanzo

inlets.description: Trigger the ramp generator, typically with a sync signal.

outlets.description: The ramp output 0..1. Speed depends on @duration attribute.
If @loop is on (default off) this sample accurately counts (accumulates) the number of loops since last reset, outputting an integer.
Sample accurate sync signal at every ramp start.
Sample accurate sync signal at every ramp end.

attributes.name: curve
attributes.description: If on (1) the ramp output is S-curve shaped. If off (0) the ramp output is linear.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Set the duration of the ramp segment in ms. If @zeroreset is on, this is only updated on ramp zero-reset boundaries.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Loop the ramp generator off/on. If off, the ramp is exclusively oneshot and only triggered by the 1st inlet. If on, the ramp behaves like a phasor.

attributes.name: pause
attributes.description: Pause (1) the ramp so that it freezes at the ramp value at the moment of engaging pause. The ramp is frozen until a 'pause 0' message is received. When coming out of pause state, the ramp simply continues from the value at which it was initially paused. Works whether @loop is on or off.

attributes.name: restingstate
attributes.description: At the end of a oneshot ramp (if @loop is off) does the ramp 'rest' at zero (0) or one (1)?

attributes.name: retrigger
attributes.description: Allow retriggering of the ramp during an active ramp segment, off/on 0/1

attributes.name: zeroreset
attributes.description: If on (1) the ramp is in zero-reset state, only updating the duration time at zero-reset crossings of the ramp. If off (0, the default) the ramp is free running.
